bot.welcome: Welcome! Send a supported single-track link and I’ll show its Track Card. Choose Download or another quality. On your first download, you’ll choose a default quality; you can change it later with /quality.
bot.help: Send a supported single-track URL. The bot will show its Track Card; choose Download or another quality. Use /quality to change the default for future cards and /language to change the interface language.
bot.send_track_url_hint: Please send a supported single-track URL.
bot.unsupported_url: That is not a supported single-track URL.
bot.unsupported_media_type: Only individual tracks are supported right now.
bot.track_resolution_failed: I couldn’t resolve this track right now. Please try again later.
bot.choose_default_quality:
Choose your default download quality:

MP3 128 — smaller file, broad compatibility
MP3 320 — higher-bitrate MP3
AAC 256 — efficient high-quality AAC
Lossless — original lossless quality when available

This quality will become your default for future downloads. You can change it later with /quality.
bot.choose_track_quality: Choose a quality for this track:
bot.track_quality_one_off_hint: This selection applies only to this track and does not change your default quality.
bot.choose_quality:
Current default: {current}

Choose a new default quality for future requests:
bot.quality_saved: Default quality saved: {quality}. It will apply to future requests.
bot.quality_saved_continuing: Default quality saved: {quality}. Preparing your original track request…
bot.quality_stale: This quality request is no longer active.
bot.preparing_download: Preparing the track… I’ll send it here when it’s ready.
bot.delivery_failed: I couldn’t deliver this track. Please try again later.
bot.no_available_provider: This track cannot be downloaded from the currently available sources.
bot.quality_unavailable: The selected quality is unavailable for this track.
bot.request_already_delivered: This request has already been delivered.
bot.request_already_started: This track request has already started or this action is stale.
bot.request_already_completed: This track request has already been completed.
bot.private_only: Please use this downloader in a private chat with the bot.
bot.invalid_selection: This selection is invalid or expired.
